svg.text: Power flows left to right. The signal that controls it flows the other way — and arrives first.
reads intent · issues setpoints · never touches protection
"20 MW job queued — full draw in 45 s"
runs at the edge · 5 s tick · no cloud dependency
islanded microgrid — no utility feed. This is the 'bring your own power' case.
load arrives here — 45 s after the signal
and the load arriving at the racks
A power-sensor system learns about the
load at 0 s — when it has already
happened. Turbines need 100 s to ramp.
stage generation ahead of predicted load
bridge the gap while the turbine ramps
shift cooling load, bounded by inlet temperature
defer or cap workload — tiers C/D need a human
verified on every run — zero occurrences at the egress boundary
Protection is the switchgear's job and stays there. GridSignal stages and advises; it never contests a relay.
